en.headline: SMH is the main reason the portfolio trails its benchmark
en.what_happened: The model portfolio fell 3.27% this week, against -1.27% for the benchmark (70% SPY / 30% AGG). Since 7 August 2026 it returned -4.39% against 0.10%, a shortfall of 4.49 percentage points.
en.why: The largest effect came from SMH: -4.49 percentage points (weight 27.0%, own return -17.32%). The strongest contribution came from GSG: +0.88 percentage points.
en.what_we_do: The rules lead to 8 trades this week; 5 new positions follow in the coming weeks because of the limit of 2 fund changes per week. The European mirror has returned -5.64% since 7 August 2026, against -4.39% for the US portfolio.
